description: Ministry of Finance - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1465/20 published under Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006. It contains an order under Section 5 of the Act that adds a new item to the Schedule, specifically addressing instruments relating to land leases by the government or Urban Development Authority. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities, making it a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
